text.card: A red giant 5,670 parsecs away, 25 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.02 solar masses and 24.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,315 K at its surface.
